rows.label: Pikachu
rows.description: Pokémon species, mascot of the Pokémon franchise
rows.hook: is a yellow electric mouse-like creature and the best-known face of a monster-collecting franchise

rows.label: Mario
rows.description: fictional character in the Mario video game franchise
rows.hook: is an Italian-American plumber who rescues a princess from the villain Bowser

rows.label: Chun-Li
rows.hook: is an Interpol officer and martial artist avenging her father, a pioneering woman in fighting games

rows.label: Ryu
rows.hook: is the headband-wearing hero of a fighting-game series, always training to become the strongest

rows.label: Sonic the Hedgehog
rows.description: video game character from the eponymous video game franchise
rows.hook: is a blue speedster who collects rings and battles Doctor Eggman

rows.label: Cuphead
rows.hook: follows two brothers who owe the Devil after a casino gamble, in a hand-drawn rubber-hose cartoon style

rows.label: Link
rows.description: main character of The Legend of Zelda video games created by Shigeru Miyamoto
rows.hook: is a green-clad hero who explores dungeons in Hyrule and battles Ganon to save a princess

rows.label: Samus Aran
rows.hook: is an armored bounty hunter raised by bird-like aliens who explores hostile planets

rows.label: Steve
rows.hook: is the default blocky player avatar in a sandbox game about mining and crafting

rows.label: Kirby
rows.hook: is a round pink puffball who can inhale enemies to copy their abilities

rows.label: Princess Peach
rows.description: fictional character from the Mario franchise
rows.hook: is the ruler of the Mushroom Kingdom, often kidnapped by Bowser

rows.label: Knuckles the Echidna
rows.description: fictional character from the Sonic franchise
rows.hook: is a red spiny anteater-like brawler who guards the Master Emerald and fights with brute strength

rows.label: Yoshi
rows.description: fictonal character in the Mario video game franchise
rows.hook: is a friendly green dinosaur who eats enemies with a long tongue and lays eggs

rows.label: Master Chief
rows.description: fictional character in the Halo video game series
rows.hook: is a towering green-armored supersoldier who fights aliens in a sci-fi shooter

rows.label: Cloud Strife
rows.hook: is a spiky-haired ex-soldier who wields an enormous buster sword

rows.label: Wario
rows.description: fictional video game character from the Mario franchise
rows.hook: is a selfish, greedy treasure hunter created as the evil opposite of a famous plumber

rows.label: GLaDOS
rows.description: fictional artificially intelligent computer system in the Portal series of video games
rows.hook: is a rogue supercomputer that runs lethal test chambers and turns on its test subject
